name: Pálmonostora (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a narrow yellow stripe along each side edge, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Pálmonostora (a quartered shield of blue and yellow, with a helm, red and blue mantling and a scroll).
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Pálmonostora arms with helm, mantling and scroll
